import { getCustomer } from './customers.js';
import { formatEuros, roundCents } from './money.js';
import { lineTotal, invoiceTotals } from './invoices.js';
import { ok } from './result.js';
import { balanceDue } from './payments.js';

export function renderInvoiceText(invoice) {
  const customerResult = getCustomer(invoice.customerId);
  if (!customerResult.ok) return customerResult;

  const customer = customerResult.value;
  const { subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total } = invoiceTotals(invoice);

  const lines = [];

  lines.push(invoice.number ?? 'DRAFT');
  lines.push(customer.name);

  for (const line of invoice.lines) {
    const lineAmount = lineTotal(line);
    const formattedUnitPrice = formatEuros(line.unitPrice);
    const formattedLineTotal = formatEuros(lineAmount);
    lines.push(`${line.qty} x ${line.name} @ ${formattedUnitPrice} = ${formattedLineTotal}`);

    if ((line.discountPercent ?? 0) > 0) {
      const lineDiscount = roundCents(lineAmount * ((line.discountPercent ?? 0) / 100));
      lines.push(`  ${line.discountPercent}% discount: -${formatEuros(lineDiscount)}`);
    }
  }

  if (discount > 0 || vat > 0 || voucher > 0) {
    lines.push(`Subtotal: ${formatEuros(subtotal)}`);
    if (discount > 0) {
      lines.push(`Discount: -${formatEuros(discount)}`);
    }
    if (vat > 0) {
      lines.push(`VAT: ${formatEuros(vat)}`);
    }
    if (voucher > 0) {
      lines.push(`Voucher: -${formatEuros(voucher)}`);
    }
  }
  lines.push(`Total: ${formatEuros(total)}`);

  return ok(lines.join('\n'));
}
